sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO TD_PERMISSION ( permission_id, permission_name, permission_code, resource_id, action, description ) VALUES ( #[permissionId], concat(#[resource], ':', #[action]), concat(#[resource], ':', #[action]), #[resource], #[action], concat(#[description], ' Condition:', ifnull(#[conditionExpr],'')) )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE TD_PERMISSION SET resource_id = #[resource], action = #[action], description = concat(#[description], ' Condition:', ifnull(#[conditionExpr],'')) WHERE permission_id = #[permissionId]
sqlMap.select: SELECT permission_id as permission_id, resource_id as resource, action as action, description as description, '' as condition_expr FROM TD_PERMISSION WHERE permission_id = #[permissionId]
SELECT permission_id as permission_id, resource_id as resource, action as action, description as description, '' as condition_expr FROM TD_PERMISSION WHERE resource_id = ? AND action = ?
SELECT permission_id as permission_id, resource_id as resource, action as action, description as description, '' as condition_expr FROM TD_PERMISSION ORDER BY resource_id, action
